jobs.description:
**About Pendulum**

Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome.

Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome.

Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale.

The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list.

If you’re interested in improving the lives of people globally and you love working in a cross-functional, collaborative, inspiring environment, please continue reading.

**Position Summary:**

Pendulum is currently seeking a Senior Research Associate (or Staff Research Associate, depending on experience) to join our Product Development team. This role will carry significant responsibility across fermentation operations and flow cytometry workflows, supporting anaerobic probiotic strain production and strain quality control, along with other exploratory lab work. Strong aseptic and anaerobic techniques are core requirements. This role's work will directly support improvements to current products as well as the development of new products.

jobs.description:
**About Jeevan**

Jeevan is a climate technology company developing novel carbon capture systems. Our work is hands-on, experimental, and fast-moving, with a strong emphasis on benchtop testing, prototyping, and data integrity. This role supports our core R&D efforts in our Alhambra facility.

**Role Overview**

This is a hands-on role combining bench-scale laboratory work with physical prototype assembly and test rig setup. The ideal candidate is comfortable both running controlled experiments and working with tools to build, modify, and troubleshoot small-scale systems. This role is well-suited to someone who enjoys building things as much as testing them.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support Jeevan’s benchtop laboratory experiments under the direction of the Lab Director.
* Prepare common lab solutions and reagents based on target specifications (e.g., calculate and prepare solutions to a desired concentration, pH, and volume).
* Conduct routine bench-scale lab experiments following written instructions (e.g., resin/column tests, batch mixing, timed procedures), and proactively communicate questions or issues.
* Operate basic lab equipment as trained, including balances, pH meters, conductivity meters, stir plates, and peristaltic pumps; verify equipment is functioning properly prior to use.
* Collect, label, and store samples properly; perform basic measurements (pH, conductivity, mass, volume) and record results in a consistent format.
* Maintain clear, organized experimental notes (including dates, procedures, calculations, deviations, and observations) and upload data and photos to shared folders.
* Monitor experiments during runs (e.g., flow rate, leaks, temperature, system stability) and immediately document abnormalities or failures.
* Clean and organize work areas, glassware, and lab tools; manage routine lab waste disposal in accordance with safety guidelines.
* Contribute to experimental design and assist with equipment assembly and test setup.
* Maintain material and equipment inventory, including tracking supply needs and assisting with ordering or local pickup when required.
* Assemble and modify benchtop and pilot-scale test rigs, including tubing runs, fittings, pumps, filters, housings, and support frames.
* Use basic hand tools (wrenches, drills, saws, tubing cutters, etc.) to fabricate and adjust prototype components.
* Troubleshoot mechanical and fluid system issues (e.g., leaks, loose fittings, flow restrictions) and implement practical fixes.
* Assist in building and maintaining scale models and early-stage prototype systems.
* Support physical setup and teardown of experiments, including moving equipment and reconfiguring systems between test runs.

**Qualifications**

* Availability for 15 - 25 hours per week during standard working hours (8:00am–5:00pm ET).
* Ability to reliably commute to and from our lab at 1135 Westminster Ave, Unit K, Alhambra, CA.
* Prior laboratory experience (academic, research, or industry) preferred.
* Comfort working with basic lab equipment and following written experimental procedures.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to document work clearly and consistently.
* Ability to work independently while communicating issues promptly and clearly.
* Prior experience with hands-on mechanical work, fabrication, or prototyping is strongly preferred.

**Work Authorization**

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States for the hours listed.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to stand for extended periods and perform hands-on lab work.
* Ability to lift and move light lab equipment and materials (generally under 25 lbs).
* Ability to safely handle lab materials while following safety protocols.

**How to Apply**

Please apply with:

* A brief introduction
* Your resume
* Your availability (days/times during the week)

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 25.0 per week

**Senior Research Associate, Preclinical Pharmacology**

*Run in vivo studies that move Nurix's degrader programs toward the clinic. You'll execute mouse efficacy, PK/PD, and mechanism-of-action studies in oncology and inflammation models and generate the Western blot and flow cytometry data that show how our molecules work.*

**Position Description**

**The Opportunity**

* Join the Research – Preclinical Pharmacology team as a full-time, onsite, hands-on member, reporting to a Scientist / Principal Scientist, Preclinical Pharmacology
* Perform mouse handling and in-life procedures, including dosing by oral (PO), intraperitoneal (IP), subcutaneous (SC), and intravenous (IV) routes, tumor cell implantation, tumor and body-weight measurements, and in-life and terminal blood collection
* Execute PK/PD, tolerability, and efficacy studies in oncology xenograft/syngeneic models and in murine models of inflammation, under the direction of study leads
* Prepare and formulate test articles and vehicles for dosing; monitor animal health, document observations, and escalate adverse events promptly
* Perform necropsy and collect, process, and bank tissues and blood for downstream biomarker and pharmacodynamic analyses
* Prepare tissue and cell lysates and perform Western blotting (including quantitative and automated capillary formats) to measure target degradation and pathway modulation
* Develop, run, and analyze multi-color flow cytometry panels for immune and tumor-cell phenotyping from blood, spleen, tumor, and other tissues
* Maintain and expand cell lines using sterile cell culture technique; support cell-based assays and the generation of cells for in vivo implantation
* Record experiments accurately and in a timely manner in the electronic lab notebook; analyze, graph, and summarize data and present results at team meetings
* Collaborate with Biology, Chemistry, DMPK, and Translational teams to design studies and troubleshoot models and assays
* Adhere to IACUC protocols, animal welfare regulations, and laboratory safety requirements, and maintain required training and certifications
* Contribute to the optimization and qualification of new models and assays and to the training of junior team members
* Maintain laboratory equipment and supplies and support vivarium coordination, including occasional weekend or off-shift study coverage; other essential duties as assigned; minimal travel (<5%)

**What You'll Bring**

* BS/MS in Biology, Pharmacology, Immunology, Cancer Biology, or a related field, with a BS or equivalent plus 8 or more years of relevant experience, or an MS plus 4 or more years of relevant experience
* Industry (biotech or pharma) experience conducting in vivo pharmacology studies in mice
* Proficiency in mouse handling and dosing by PO, IP, SC, and IV routes, as well as blood collection and tissue harvest
* Hands-on experience with oncology models (e.g., xenograft, syngeneic) and with murine models of inflammation or immunology
* Demonstrated proficiency in Western blotting and flow cytometry, including sample preparation, staining, and data analysis
* Proficiency in sterile mammalian cell culture technique
* Working knowledge of IACUC regulations and humane animal care practices
* Strong organizational and documentation skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple studies simultaneously
* Collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable in a fast-paced, team-oriented research environment
* Ability to work in an animal facility and tolerate exposure to laboratory animals, and to work occasional weekends or off-shift hours as studies require
* Bonus: experience with targeted protein degradation (molecular glues, PROTACs) or other small-molecule oncology or immunology programs
* Bonus: experience with multi-spectral flow cytometry, automated Western (e.g., Jess/Wes), ELISA, or MSD cytokine/biomarker assays
* Bonus: experience with orthotopic, disseminated, PDX, or humanized mouse models, or with in vivo imaging
* Bonus: experience with inflammation models such as collagen-induced arthritis, colitis, or cytokine-challenge models
* Bonus: familiarity with PK/PD relationships, compound formulation, and dose-response study design
* Bonus: proficiency with GraphPad Prism and electronic lab notebook systems

**Salary Range:** $131,400 - $139,900

*The posted range applies to roles based in the San Francisco Bay Area and reflects local market conditions. Where an offer lands within that range depends on the candidate's relevant experience, technical expertise, and how their background aligns with the role's requirements.*

**Location:** Onsite – Brisbane, CA

  

**Fit with Nurix Culture and Values**

* Strong team orientation; highly collaborative
* Solutions and results-oriented focus
* Hands-on approach; resourceful and open to diverse points of view

*Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix's dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine's next chapter with a new script to outmatch disease.*
